tha-ap61:1.1: samattaṃ. [59. Paduma.] Catusaccaṃ pakāse*nto varadhammacakka*pavattako / vassate amataṃ vuṭṭhiṃ nibbāpento mahājanaṃ. // //
tha-ap61:2.1: Sadhajaṃ padumaṃ gayha aḍḍhakose ṭṭhito ahaṃ / Padumuttaramunissa haṭṭho ukkhi*pim ambare.* // //
tha-ap61:3.1: Āgacchante ca padume abbhūto āsi *tāvade* / mama saṅkappam aññāya paggaṇhi vadataṃ varo. // //
tha-ap61:4.1: Karaseṭṭhena paggayha jalajaṃ puppham uttamaṃ / {bhikkhusaṅghe} ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap61:5.1: Yen' idaṃ padumaṃ khittaṃ sabbaññuta-m-anāsave / *tam ahaṃ kit*tayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap61:6.1: Tiṃsakappāni devindo devarajjaṃ karissati / paṭhavyā rajjaṃ sattasataṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati. // //
tha-ap61:7.1: Tattha pattaṃ gahetvāna cakkavatti bhavissati / ākāsato pupphavuṭṭhi abhivassissati tadā. // //
tha-ap61:8.1: Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap61:9.1: Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso *dhammani*mmito / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat' anāsavo. // //
tha-ap61:10.1: Nikkhamitvāna kucchimhā sampajāno patissato / jātiyā pañcavasso 'haṃ arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ. // //
tha-ap61:11.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap61:12.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padumo thero imā gāthāyo abhā- sitthā ti.
